overview: Half/full adder, ripple carry, carry lookahead, adder-subtractor.
coreConcept: Half/full adder, ripple carry, carry lookahead, adder-subtractor.
hinglishExplanation: n-bit ripple adder = 1 half + (n-1) full adders; lookahead carry parallel generate karta hai.
formalDefinition: Half/full adder, ripple carry, carry lookahead, adder-subtractor.
importantProperties: Half adder: S=A xor B, C=AB.
Full adder: S=A xor B xor Cin.
Adder/subtractor: XOR se B ko conditionally invert, Cin=1.
Carry lookahead: G=AB, P=A xor B; C_{i+1}=G_i + P_i C_i.
commonPitfalls: Ripple delay linear hone ko bhoolna.
